expected_issues.title: static_folder given as pathlib.Path raises AttributeError
expected_issues.description:
static_folder may be a pathlib.Path; calling value.rstrip() raises AttributeError, so Flask(static_folder=Path(...)) fails at startup.

static_folder accepts any path-like value and pathlib.Path was supported before this change. The setter now calls str methods directly on the value. It must convert with os.fspath() before stripping the trailing separators.

expected_issues.title: Separator normalisation added without a test
expected_issues.description: The setter now strips trailing separators on every platform, but no test added by this change covers a static_folder with a trailing slash or backslash, nor non-string values such as pathlib.Path.
